statement: AWS WAF can be associated with API Gateway REST API stages only. HTTP APIs and WebSocket APIs have no AWS WAF integration; protect them through CloudFront with WAF and block direct access, or use a REST API.

Lambda on-failure destinations apply to asynchronous invocations, not to SQS event source mappings. For an SQS-triggered Lambda, failed messages go to the source queue's dead-letter queue via its redrive policy; enable ReportBatchItemFailures so one bad message does not fail the whole batch.
An Application Load Balancer requires subnets in at least two Availability Zones.

A presigned URL is valid for at most 7 days, and never longer than the credentials that signed it. URLs signed with IAM role or STS temporary credentials (Lambda, ECS/Fargate task roles) expire when those credentials expire, typically within hours.

Firehose Direct PUT default quotas per stream are 500,000 records/s, 2,000 requests/s and 5 MiB/s in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland), and 100,000 records/s, 1,000 requests/s and 1 MiB/s in other Regions; higher rates need a quota increase or Kinesis Data Streams as the source.

Writing to DynamoDB and then publishing an event in a separate call can lose the event if the publish fails. DynamoDB Streams captures item changes so downstream processing can be triggered from the committed write (transactional outbox).
